user_reported_method: Read all 295 prompt lines in chunks in the main conversation; manually classify all 70 cases; no sub-agent.

issues.detail: No prediction frozen_manifest exists; the source manifest covers inputs only.
The archived Agent-tool transport allowed tools; instruction-level prohibition does not establish tool or filesystem isolation.
The extension has no captured provider-native request/response and tool-event chain authenticating its delivered context and completion.
Caller-written model names and a MODEL_ID self-report are not provider-returned model identity evidence.
Current output hashes and answer_keys_read=false cannot demonstrate pre-score answer-key isolation.
The session schedule does not enumerate the same 18 model/group identities as the extension protocol and output paths.

interpretation: Neither a new hash, removal of an integrity flag nor exactly ten predictions per class proves or disproves contamination. Existing-context chunked processing is not the frozen fresh full-request protocol. No accuracy computed; no predictions or metadata modified.
